title: HandLive — relay op pair_revoked (relay → device)
description: 0.7.3, PAIR-03 API 4, SET-02 API 5: the pair has been revoked; sent as soon as it happens and again when the device reconnects (pairs revoked within 30 days, revoked_notice). Carries the revoking device's HLREVOKE1 statement (0.6.2, test-vectors/revoke.json); a receiver acts on it only when by is the peer of that pair and sig verifies with the peer's stored ik_sig public key. Repeats are ignored.

by.description: device_id of the device that revoked the pair.

revoked_at.description: Milliseconds, as signed in the statement.

sig.description: Ed25519(ik_sig of by, "HLREVOKE1" ‖ pair_id (16) ‖ by (16) ‖ revoked_at (uint64 BE)).
